title: After a hand switch, Time Clock off still turns Technician off for good
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open the New Staff Member window.
  2. If Time Clock is off, switch it on.
  3. In Role, pick "Parts Manager".
  4. Switch Technician on.
  5. Switch Time Clock off.
  6. Switch Time Clock on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Staff Member window opens.

Step 2:

  • Time Clock is on.

Step 3:

  • Technician is off.

Step 4:

  • Technician is on.

Step 5:

  • Technician switches off and is grayed out.

Step 6:

  • Time Clock is on.
  • Technician stays off.
  • Technician is not grayed out and can be switched on by hand.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-R3: “In the New Staff Member window, Technician is pre-filled from the role shown: on when the role is the built-in Technician or the built-in Foreman role and Time Clock is on, otherwise off. Every other role pre-fills off, including Parts Technician and every custom role, even one made from Technician or Foreman. The pre-fill runs when the window opens and again each time the role or Time Clock is changed, until the user switches Technician by hand. From then on the user's choice wins: changing the role or Time Clock no longer pre-fills it, though S1-R4 and S1-N1 still turn it off, and only the user turns it back on. The toggle as shown is what is saved. Edit Staff Member never pre-fills (S1-E1).”
  • S1-R4: “Technician can only be on while Time Clock is on. While Time Clock is off, the Technician toggle is off and grayed out, and hovering it shows "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians." Turning Time Clock off, in the window or any other way (for example through the Public API), turns Technician off.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "3 When Technician can't be turned on", picture "Time Clock off" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p3-01-after-time-clock-off.png

The design's own words:

  • “Technician needs Time Clock. While Time Clock is off, Technician is off and grayed out. Tooltip, verbatim: "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians."”
  • “Turning Time Clock off turns Technician off. Turning Time Clock back on leaves Technician off; the user turns it on.”
